text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning, I catch sight of Special Week as she's on her way to class.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mmm… I need to think more about positioning… Yaaawn.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! The race… It was all a dream…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I've been thinking nonstop about the race… And it kept me up late again… Yaaawn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Special Week is having trouble sleeping. I need to take that into consideration.
